name: ebook-hub
title: Ebook Hub
description: Read, import, and share freely licensed ebooks with Vim-style navigation and Hue themes.
author: crafts69guy

commands.name: library
commands.title: My Library
commands.description: Browse, read, and manage the books in your local library.

commands.name: continue-reading
commands.title: Continue Reading
commands.description: Open the last book you were reading at your saved position.

commands.name: import-book
commands.title: Import Book
commands.description: Import a Markdown, text, EPUB, or PDF file into your library.

commands.name: browse-community
commands.title: Browse Community Library
commands.description: Discover freely licensed books shared by the community and add them to your library.

preferences.name: theme
preferences.title: Reading Theme
preferences.description: Hue mood used for accents and the Apply Hue Theme action.

preferences.name: wordsPerPage
preferences.title: Words per Page
preferences.description: How many words fit on one reader page (100–2000).

preferences.name: focusMode
preferences.title: Focus Mode
preferences.label: Hide progress while reading
preferences.description: Show only the book title in the reader's navigation title.

preferences.name: communityIndexUrl
preferences.title: Community Library Index
preferences.description: HTTPS URL of the community library index.json.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
